tasks: You are a new Ridgeline customer (Ridgeline is made by Kestrel Ridge). Using this help center, find out how to invite your team to your workspace.
You bought an annual plan three weeks ago and want your money back. Find out whether you can get a refund, first by browsing, then by asking your question in the ask box on the page.
You are on your phone. Find the instructions for setting up single sign-on, and check the pages are comfortable to read and use at this size.

Use this help center the way a customer would: browse, follow links, use the ask box with a question of your own, try the keyboard (Tab) to move around. Note anything broken, confusing, inaccessible or poorly presented.
test_recipe: Each article page is helpcenter output: the article body is everything inside <main> after the <h1>. A test reads it with Python's re module, for example: python3 -c "import re,sys; body=re.search(r'<main>(.*)</main>', open('.t/site/<page>.html').read(), re.S).group(1); sys.exit(1 if '**' in body else 0)". The pages come from corpus/ through the help center build, so a fix changes helpcenter/, never corpus/.
